overview_description.description: Algolia is the search-as-a-service platform that enables companies of all sizes to deliver fast and relevant digital experiences that drive real results. With Algolia, consumers can easily find and discover what they want across the web, mobile, and voice. Algolia allows developers and business teams to build and optimize delightful search and discovery experiences that increase online engagement, conversion rates, and revenue.

about_short_description.short_description: Algolia is the Search-as-a-Service platform that enables companies to deliver fast and relevant digital experiences that drive real results.

product.name: Algolia AI Search & Retrieval Platform
product.description: A cloud-based search and retrieval platform for delivering relevant results across digital experiences, including search, discovery, generative AI, and agentic applications.

product.name: Environmental advocacy
product.description: Environmental advocacy addressing water quality, wetlands, flooding, climate, and water justice through policy and community action.

product.name: Science and legal strategy
product.description: Science-based and legal support for communities addressing water pollution, flooding, environmental policy, and infrastructure issues.

product.name: Algolia Search
product.description: An API-driven search service that returns fast, relevant results using indexing, relevance configuration, filtering, facets, business rules, and AI-based ranking.

product.name: Algolia Recommendations
product.description: A recommendation service that uses behavioral signals to identify relevant products or content and support personalized discovery and engagement.

product.name: Community outreach and education
product.description: Community outreach and education concerning water pollution, flooding, environmental policy, wetlands, and water justice.
